QuestInfo.name: Off to Fantasy Theme World
QuestInfo.0: Have you been to Fantasy Theme World lately? Well, it seems like it's not as fun a place as it used to be. #b#p9270062##k said something scary is going on in there. Go see #b#p9270062##k for the details!
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9270062##k said there are 2 fierce monsters in Fantasy Theme World, scaring off all the visitors. If nobody stops them, they'll run Fantasy Theme World into the ground. #b#p9270062##k said he knows how to draw out those monsters. You must help him by taking care of some monsters causing trouble in the village and by completing the Away from Kampung quest. Then he shall tell you how to defeat those creatures!
QuestInfo.2: Talk to #b#p9270047##k at the Entrance to the Spooky World, and she will let you in. There's still time to save Fantasy Theme World!

0.0: Looking for fun and excitement? Then Fantasy Theme World is just the place for you! Well, it was. It's rather dangerous to go near these days. So it might still be the place for you, depending.
0.1: My dear friend #bAldol#k told me that Fantasy Theme World is being attacked by some terrrible creatures, and she's the only one keeping the place safe from them. But they're becoming stronger every day, and she's desperately looking for some help.
0.2: I need you to show me your mettle first. Please stop #b50 rampaging #o9420539#s#k bring me #b50 #t4000471#s#k. You will also need to help me build a merry-go-round for the children of the village.
0.3: I will tell you how to find those dangerous creatures after you help me. Are you willing to face those creatures?

yes.0: That's great! Those creatures are hiding out in the Spooky World. They're clever enough to stay hidden from most people, disguised as stone statues.
yes.1: They can only be drawn out by #b#t4032246#s#k. I'll give them to you if you help me with a few things.

no.0: Oh no, please help us keep Fantasy Theme World going! Come talk to me if you ever change your mind.

1.0: Okay, let's see if you got what I've asked for.
1.1: Okay, this is the deal with Fantasy Theme World. Lately, there have been 2 monsters that terrorize the guests and wreck everything. Several brave Maplers tried to defeat them, but these two are so sneaky, they transform themselves into something else to hide.
1.2: The #b#t4032246#s#k I gave you actually contain a real spirits that will break their disguise. But listen, do NOT call both of them at the same time! They might look small, but they are too fierce to be faced together.
1.3: Now, with that in mind, are you sure you still want to confront them?

yes.0: Okay, here is a spirit doll for each statue. Put it under the statue to wake the beasts. Bring friends if you can...these things are not to be taken lightly.
yes.1: You must talk to Aldol. She's waiting for you at the entrance of the Spooky World.

item.0: I told you that I need you to defeat #b50 #o9420539#s#k bring me #b50 #t4000471#s#k. Can you do this for me?

quest.0: Will you be able to help me finish the merry-go-round?
